doc.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: First jazz recordings with Billy Taylor
summary: His first jazz recording was with Billy Taylor, about five in a year, and his style drew requests from many jazz artists.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Maestro let’s go back to review in detail your collaborations, recordings with renowned jazz artists. Let's start with Billy Taylor.
It was my first recording in the jazz scene. It was my first recording with Billy Taylor.
How many years were you with him?
About five times. Yes, about five times. Most of them have come out on CD now - of those recordings from 1952, most have come out now on CD.
To some extent you defined a style of playing Cuban percussion to accompany jazz that was really liked.
And that style was solicited - your services, as a consequence of that? . . . Your services were requested by many great jazz musicians.
